title: What's New in QuickBar Pro v1.0.2
changelog:
🚀 New Features

- Text Animations: 20+ text animation presets with live preview
- Smooth kinetic typography with customizable easing curves
- Drag-and-drop text presets directly onto timeline layers
- Real-time text animation scrubbing in the preview panel

🛠️ Improvements

- Faster preset loading with lazy-load caching
- Improved timeline rendering performance by 30%
- Smoother canvas interactions with requestAnimationFrame
- Better undo/redo stack management for bulk operations
- Enhanced search with weighted result scoring

🐛 Bug Fixes

- Fixed text animation not applying to pre-comp layers
- Fixed preview panel freezing with 50+ layers
- Fixed export crash on long timeline sequences
- Fixed preset thumbnails not loading on first launch
- Fixed keyboard shortcuts conflicting with AE defaults
